Definition: from the same as G2059; translation:--interpretation.
BiblicalUsage: hermēneía means interpretation. It turns up twice, in 1 Corinthians.
TheologicalSignificance: I take hermēneía as it stands — interpretation — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
